_doc: The style library's families and tag words: the one place they are defined. A family is what the picture looks like;
each style belongs to exactly one, named by id in its own tokens.json ("family"). The order of `families` is the order
of styles/README.md's sections and of `bin/vh style list`. `tags` are the words a style's tokens.json "tags" may use,
one value per dimension. Video types (tokens.json "video_types") are the numbers of video-types/NN-*.md.
tools/styles.py reads this file; `bin/vh style check` holds every style to it, and `python3 tools/styles.py readme`
writes the README's tables from it. Rename a family here and in the tokens.json of its styles; nothing else names it.

families.line_zh: 边讲边画出来的图：白板、黑板、线稿、图解、剖面。东西是一笔笔画出来、拆开来给人看懂的
families.line_en: Drawn while it is explained: whiteboards, chalk, line art, diagrams and cutaways, built stroke by stroke

families.line_zh: 画出来的画面：水彩、油画、钢笔淡彩、扁平矢量插画，看得见颜料和笔触
families.line_en: Painted pictures: watercolour, oil, pen and wash, flat vector illustration; the paint and the brush show

families.line_zh: 印出来、剪出来的平面：网点、专色套印、木刻、铜版、丝印、剪纸拼贴，套不准和纸纹是味道
families.line_en: Printed and cut: halftone, spot colours, woodcut, engraving, screen print, cut-paper collage; misregistration and paper are the flavour

families.line_zh: 东方和西方的老手艺：水墨、壁画、皮影、剪纸、年画、浮世绘、彩色玻璃，材料和纹样都要考据
families.line_en: Old crafts, East and West: ink wash, murals, shadow puppets, paper cuts, woodblock prints, stained glass; materials and motifs researched

families.line_zh: 真实材料做的小世界：黏土、毛毡、折纸、积木、纸雕、桌面微缩，一拍二地动
families.line_en: Small worlds of real material: clay, felt, folded paper, bricks, pop-up paper, tabletop miniatures, often on twos

families.line_zh: 真素材和证据当主角：档案照片、字幕新闻、调查复原、口播图解，每个标注都有出处
families.line_en: Real material and evidence lead: archive photos, captioned news, investigations, talking heads with graphics; every label sourced

families.line_zh: 画面就是一块屏幕：界面卡片、终端、HUD、桌面录屏、表格、代码编辑器
families.line_en: The picture is a screen: interface cards, terminals, HUDs, desktops, spreadsheets, code editors

families.line_zh: 像某种摄影机、胶片或录像拍出来的：颗粒、色调、抽帧、构图和刮痕都来自那种影像和它的年代
families.line_en: As if shot on a certain camera, stock or tape: grain, grade, step-printing, framing and scratches from that medium and its era

families.line_zh: 卡通和游戏的画法：扁平卡通、橡皮管、赛璐珞、像素、漫画分格，靠夸张的动作和游戏的规则讲事
families.line_en: Cartoon and game drawing: flat cartoons, rubber hose, cel, pixels, comic panels; told through big motion and game rules

families.line_zh: 立体的形和真实的光：棚拍产品、体积光、玻璃、霓虹、巨大的形体和走进去的世界
families.line_en: Solid form and real light: studio products, volumetric light, glass, neon, monumental shapes, worlds to walk into

families.line_zh: 画面在量一样东西：地图、图表、图形统计、仪器读数，数字和位置都是真的
families.line_en: The picture measures something: maps, charts, pictograms, instrument readouts; the numbers and places are real

families.line_zh: 字和纯平面图形本身就是画面：网格排字、动态字、梗图排版、铬字贴纸、几何构成
families.line_en: Type and pure graphic shapes are the picture: grid typography, kinetic type, meme layouts, chrome and stickers, geometric play

calm.line: 慢动、长停、留白多，一个动作一个动作地来

medium.line: 讲解片的稳步节奏：每拍有一件事，但不赶

fast.line: 卡拍硬切，几乎每拍一个动作一个声音

landscape.line: 语法离不开宽画面（长卷、地平线、横向的舞台）

portrait.line: 为竖屏而生（字幕新闻、笔记卡），横屏反而别扭

both.line: 换成 9:16 重新构图也成立；样片另出一个竖版

seconds.line: Canvas 2D、SVG、轻的着色器：一段样片一分钟内渲完

minutes.line: 全屏逐像素着色器、Three.js 场景：一段样片要几分钟

blender.line: 路径追踪的光和真实景深（Cycles）：一段样片几十分钟起

masterwork.line: 从电影、动画、设计和美术的名作里拉片提炼

community.line: 从社区里用 agent 做的作品、skill 和公开视频里提炼，只借画面类型

own-film.line: 从用这个仓库做过的片子里成形的画面语言提炼；起中性的名字，不出现频道和片名
